Annotation Interface TransactionalRecoverable

@Documented @Retention(RUNTIME) @Target({ANNOTATION_TYPE,METHOD,TYPE}) public @interface TransactionalRecoverable
Marks a Transactional method or type as eligible for commit-outcome recovery.

The initial implementation is Oracle JDBC only and is applied only to synchronous transactional execution. Recovery is attempted only for the intercepted execution that starts and owns a new transaction; participating calls still execute normally and leave any ambiguous commit outcome to the outer transaction boundary.

If Oracle reports that the transaction committed but the user call did not complete, Micronaut returns the original result and logs a warning instead of replaying the call.

This annotation is intentionally a marker companion to Transactional; it does not copy transactional attributes.

Since:
5.1
